FOLDER TEMPLATE POSTER SERIES
=============================
Silakan masukkan file poster series kamu ke dalam folder ini:
Path: public/assets/series/

Daftar nama file default:
1. black-mirror.jpg (atau .png, .webp)
2. stranger-things.jpg
3. the-end-of-the-fing-world.jpg
4. alice-in-borderland.jpg
5. squid-game.jpg
